locator: I q.11 a.3 co., second proof: Ostensum est enim supra quod Deus comprehendit in se totam perfectionem essendi
interpretation: Aquinas' back-reference to q.4 a.2, read as being about the prima via's first mover; 'having a perfection' is read as being in act in a respect, formally or eminently. q.4 a.2 argues it from God as first efficient cause (the second way), which this corpus has not formalized, so it is an open premise on the root path.
